nom: IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Dark Spots Niacinamide Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as hydrating and softening, though one with combination-to-dry skin noticed little effect on dark spots since she had no major pigmentation to begin with.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and good results even applying more often than directed, while others describe burning, a purging rash, or harshness that required cutting back to twice a week.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying as combination-to-dry skin found the texture more gel/oil-like than watery serums she'd used and noticed little change, having no major concern to begin with.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 60s+ report fading of age spots, sun spots, and fine lines with continued use over weeks to years, with one 69-year-old saying it has maintained spot-free skin for years.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for age spots, sun damage, and fine lines report lightening and smoother-looking skin over weeks to months, and one long-term user says it maintained spot-free skin for years; one reviewer also felt it made fine lines around eyes/cheekbones worse due to dryness.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers found it hydrating with a plumper, softer feel, but others report it caused dryness or worsened dryness around the eyes and cheekbones.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports reduced redness alongside fading dark spots; no other redness-specific reports appear.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes a purging rash and irritation on sensitive skin, while another notes it helped support the moisture barrier with no irritation; effects appear inconsistent across sensitive users.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark spots, sun spots, age spots, or melasma report visible fading within two weeks to a few months, some describing spots as nearly or fully gone; a notable minority (about a dozen) report no visible change after months of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report shrinking acne pimples or fewer breakouts alongside fading scarring, but one reviewer notes new breakouts appearing after a month of use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with large pores and acne-prone skin reports the serum helped with pore appearance without irritation; no other oiliness-specific reports appear.

aspects.libelle: Slow results requiring months of patience

extraits.texte: I'm a POC with light-medium brown skin, and I have sensitive skin. I used this product mostly as intended, as in twice a day, before any spf, moisturizer, etc. for a good 2-3 months. Im human so of course i forgot occasionally but regardless I expected better results. I had both old and new acne scarring, neither of which actually went away after using this product for so long. The dark spots lightened a little bit, the newer acne scarring more than the others. This was the second dark spot treatment i tried as it was half off when i bought it. I don't intend on purchasing this again. Many people raved about the product in the reviews, I am disappointed it did not work for me. My understanding is that many of these dark spot treatment products dont work too well with POC. I do appreciate that this did not agitate my sensitive skin and how easy it was to apply, its a lightweight serum.

extraits.titre: Effective for dark spots but accentuates lines & dryness
extraits.texte: Pros: Fades sun spots, starts working within a week Light-weight, absorbs quickly Cons: Salicylic acid in the formulation causes dryness around eyes/cheekbones making fine lines worse; skin lost its normal moisture/elasticity Smells like cheap perfume

It Cosmetics Bye Bye Dark Spot Niacinamide is extremely light and surprisingly very refreshing after first application. Unfortunately, I have extremely sensitive skin and this caused a minor purging rash on my face and neck, so I had to completely stop using the product. Normally, It Cosmetics products has never caused my skin to react like this so I was surprised. With that being said I didn't get to use the product long enough to see any positive results but based on other reviews majority of customers have had very promising positive results. Loved the product packaging though, made for a very easy application with the dropper applicator.

I have struggled with Sun damage and melasma after my 3 child was born. I tried the bye bye dark spots serum with very low expectations since I've tried many products before. I starting applying the serum every morning before skin care and after 6 weeks, other people started to mention how my skin looks so clear now. It's been about 3 months now and my dark spots have faded. I feel comfortable going out without foundation now.

extraits.titre: Obssed with my very visible results!

This product showed REAL visible results after just a few days use and even way more visible results after continueing to use for going on 5 weeks. I am just is awe at the difference I can actually see and feel! My dark spots have lightened up and the redness has gone down alot! I can also see my wrinkles slowly disappearing. My skin just looks and feels amazing. This product works well for all skin types, even sensitive skin and is Dematologist tested making this a product I trust! If anyone is familiar with paula choice or skin ceutical vit c, watery texture, then this is completely different.
